card.name: Space before step-up dose amount
card.fires_on: The space right after "increase by", "increments of" or "increased by" in dose-titration text, just before the step amount in mg is given.

modes.label: Increase by
modes.description: The space after "increase(d) by" just before the amount of each dose step.
modes.example: Increase the dosage by<< >>1000 mg/day every

modes.label: Increments of
modes.description: The space after "increments of" or "increases of" before the step size.
modes.example: followed by increases of<< >>2 mg/day at weekly or longer intervals

card.writes: It prepares the model to write a number and unit for the step size, though the listed tokens are unclear.
card.plain: It fires at the blank just before the size of a dose step-up is stated, as in "increase by ___ mg".
